integrity: Self-contained algebraic derivation, exact rational independent generator tests and symbolic factor checks. Unlimited-parameter assertions are proved analytically. No third-party scientific validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent harmonic Brownian modes, a single complete zero-reset Poisson clock, all positive relaxation and diffusion rates, stationary distinct-label energy statistics only; no claim for nonlinear, partially reset, locally reset or interacting models. The equal-relaxation boundary follows from existing beta-law work. Priority against an unindexed general cumulant identity remains unverified.
title: A unique three-energy sign crossover under heterogeneous global resetting
